rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for restoring battery power, and it is also used figuratively for taking time to rest and regain energy.

example.english: My phone is dead, so I need to recharge it.
example.traditional: 我部電話冇電，要攞去叉電喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bou6 din6 waa2 mou5 din6 jiu3 lo2 heoi3 caa1 din6 laa3

rows.note: Use this specifically when putting ammunition into a gun rather than restoring electrical power or personal energy.

example.english: The gun is out of bullets, so I need to recharge it before I can keep firing.
example.traditional: 部槍冇彈，我要上彈先可以繼續開槍。
example.jyutping: bou6 coeng1 mou5 daan6 ngo5 jiu3 soeng5 daan2 sin1 ho2 ji5 gai3 zuk6 hoi1 coeng1
